claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_hit_intercept
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Mirror Image creates a persistent passive trigger that fires automatically when the caster is hit by an attack roll — no reaction cost, no player prompt, no Prepare/Prompt/Commit chain. This is structurally distinct from triggered_reaction (which requires a reaction-slot cast and the decision chain) and from ongoing_effect (whose operations are roll_modifier and damage_on_hit). The spell plants a 'on_incoming_hit_window' that resolves before damage is applied, gated by a probabilistic die check, consuming one token from a countable pool.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a d6 for each of your remaining duplicates.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: duplicate_pool resource
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell creates exactly 3 destroyable tokens (duplicates) that serve as an ablative HP-like pool for the spell's interception mechanism. This is not use_count (which tracks activations of a feature), not spell_slot (consumed at cast), and not charge (charge items have a maximum and recharge). A duplicate_pool is a fixed-count token set that depletes as each token is destroyed by the interception mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. [...] one of the duplicates is hit instead of you, and the duplicate is destroyed. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_incoming_hit_window
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Mirror Image fires before the hit resolves — between the attacker rolling a hit and damage being applied. The existing on_hit_window fires after a hit is confirmed (attacker-side, grants a rider). Mirror Image needs an incoming-hit window on the defender side, which opens automatically (no action cost) and can negate the hit entirely by redirecting it. This is distinct from on_hit_window and from reaction_window (no reaction slot consumed).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a d6 for each of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: probabilistic_gate resolution
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The interception check is 'roll Nd6, succeed if any die >= 3' where N = remaining duplicate count. This is neither an attack_roll, save_gate, nor ability_check. It is a pool-size-dependent probabilistic check with a fixed threshold. The surface has no resolution type for multi-die threshold checks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: roll a d6 for each of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: intercept_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The successful resolution redirects the hit from the caster to a duplicate (destroying the duplicate). v4 has block_targeting (prevents being targeted before a roll) and grant_resistance (halves damage). Neither covers 'hit is retroactively redirected to a proxy token that is then destroyed'. This is a distinct deterministic effect: the caster takes no damage and no effects from the hit; the hit resolves against and destroys the duplicate.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: one of the duplicates is hit instead of you, and the duplicate is destroyed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects.
